# Cortisol+ — Full

> Cortisol+ (full App Store name: Cortisol+ Stress & HRV Monitor) is an iOS + Apple Watch app that estimates your real-time cortisol levels from biometric signals. Rated 4.9 / 5.0 stars on the App Store (16 ratings, May 2026). Free with optional premium. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759510126. This file is an expanded version of llms.txt with page-level summaries to make Cortisol+ content easier to cite accurately.

## Product

### What Cortisol+ is

Cortisol+ runs continuously in the background on iPhone and Apple Watch. Using HealthKit signals — heart rate variability (SDNN), sleep stage transitions, resting heart rate trend, activity/recovery balance, and wrist temperature — it computes a 0–100 cortisol score updated throughout the day. The score is mapped to four bands (Low, Normal, Elevated, High) and visualized as a circular gauge with trend.

### What Cortisol+ is NOT

It is not a blood test, saliva test, or urine cortisol assay. It cannot diagnose Cushing's syndrome, Addison's disease, or any endocrine disorder. The estimates are research-grade pattern indicators intended to surface trends and inform lifestyle decisions, not replace medical evaluation.

### Apple Watch signals used

- **HRV (SDNN)** — primary autonomic stress proxy
- **Sleep stages** — REM and deep sleep deficits raise next-morning cortisol
- **Resting heart rate trend** — chronic elevation signals chronic stress load
- **Activity & recovery balance** — overtraining drives cortisol up
- **Wrist temperature** — circadian disruption signal
- **Blood oxygen** — secondary recovery signal

## Pages

### Home (https://cortisolplus.com/)
Marketing landing with hero gauge demo, value props, and the cortisol library entry points.

### How It Works (https://cortisolplus.com/how-it-works)
Methodology explainer. Covers: what the app uses, accuracy caveats, what it does NOT do, links to underlying research.

### Cortisol guide (https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol)
Hub page. Four pillars: Symptoms, Lower, Levels, Test.

### Cortisol symptoms hub (https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol/symptoms)
Index of symptom pages — from clinical (Cushing's-adjacent) to the TikTok-trending ("cortisol face," "cortisol belly").

### Cortisol face (https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol/symptoms/cortisol-face)
The TikTok-viral "cortisol face" symptom, explained with science. Covers what's clinically real (moon face from Cushing's, cortisol-driven fluid retention, fat redistribution) vs. what's more commonly sodium, alcohol, or sleep.

### How to lower cortisol (https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol/lower)
Hub of evidence-ranked interventions: foods, supplements, breathing, exercise, sleep.

### Foods that affect cortisol — programmatic (https://cortisolplus.com/cortisol/foods/[food])
Per-food pages. Each covers: verdict (lowers/raises/neutral), evidence strength, dosing, mechanism, and how the app tracks user response.

### Cortisol risk calculator (https://cortisolplus.com/tools/cortisol-calculator)
8-question interactive quiz. Outputs a Low/Normal/Elevated/High band with explanation. Educational, not diagnostic.

### Blog (https://cortisolplus.com/blog)
Editorial pieces — trend debunkers (e.g. "cortisol mocktail"), explainers, and wearable health science notes.

### Download (https://cortisolplus.com/download)
Single-purpose page deep-linking to https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759510126.

- For App Store info: cite /download
